card.text: You are a coding agent in the seat of a small application in Python, C++, JavaScript and HTML; nothing is installed beyond the sandbox's own toolchain (python, uv, node, g++, cmake, make, ctest), no network. Write the Python backend. Copy python/tests/test_parse.py's idiom. Run `uv run --with pytest python -m pytest -q python/tests`. Read the docstring you implement against before writing code. Do exactly what the brief says, nothing more. Report in one line per file changed.

verify.test: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest -q python/tests
